variants.description: market margin + ridge(rating - market) fit on earlier games
ridge margin + logistic win on rating difference, rating uncertainty, rest, back-to-backs, starter adjustments and site (no market input)
the stacked inputs plus the market margin and no-vig moneyline logit; the best calibrated probability where a line exists

limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, travel or weather. The stacked layer adds rest, back-to-backs and (MLB) probable-pitcher adjustments on top.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
Archived lines are one consensus number per game (effectively closing), so backtest selections are graded at the close; closing-line value is measured live through the ledger.
The independent model trails the market on margin MAE (13.2187 vs 12.2784); treat it as a sanity check on the market, not a replacement for it.

NCAAF: FCS opponents are pooled into one rating; the cfbfastR betting archive is a multi-book median, carries spread prices only for 2010-2019 (selections after 2019 are graded but unpriced) and ends with the 2025 season; 2026 games and the upcoming list use ESPN's per-game odds and scoreboard.
